Container.Name: listening-dungeon-abs-stats
Container.Overview: Companion to The Listening Dungeon. Reads listening stats, finished books and series from your Audiobookshelf server and serves them to the game. It only reads, except when a player taps "add this series to my playlist" on the Recommendations page.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: The game connects here. Change the left side if 3000 is taken (and use that port in the game's abs-stats address).

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf address
Config.Description: Your ABS server as this container can reach it, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:13378 (not localhost).

Config.Name: ABS admin API token
Config.Description: API token of an ABS admin user (ABS: Settings, Users, your admin user, API token).

Config.Name: Players' own tokens
Config.Description: Optional: username:token,username2:token2. Unlocks each player's own playlists and per-user extras.

Config.Name: Players
Config.Description: Comma-separated ABS usernames to include, or * for everyone. Match the game's Players setting.

Config.Name: Game address
Config.Description: Where abs-stats reaches the game (same idea as the game's abs-stats address).
